description: Deichregister Sachsen-Anhalt is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geodatenportal.sachsen-anhalt.de. According to § 94 Wassergesetz des Landes Sachsen-Anhalt (WG LSA) of 11.10.2025, the dyke register is kept in digital form by the Landesbetrieb für Flowasserschutz und Wasserwirtschaft (LHW) and regularly updated. The dyke register shall take effect upon its publication. The same applies to changes to the dyke register. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Dike register Saxony-Anhalt" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Überflutung, Leitdeich, Qualmdeich, Deichregister, Rückstaudeich, Teilschutzdeich. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2025-03-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
